summary.text: Steven Sanders is a No Labels Party write-in candidate for Arizona's 4th Congressional District. A Phoenix native and U.S. Army veteran, he has worked as an aviation mechanic and manager. He also ran as a write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Arizona in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Born in Phoenix, Arizona; graduated from Sunnysloe High School (as spelled by Ballotpedia) and attended Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
Served in the U.S. Army from 1986 to 1991.
Career experience includes work as a manager and as an aviation mechanic with an FAA airframe and powerplant license.
Ran as a write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Arizona in 2024, receiving 92 votes (0.0 percent), listed as an Independent.
Has been affiliated with the Roosevelts Rough Rider (as listed by Ballotpedia) and the Boy Scouts of America.
